verses.text: Do not celebrate, Israel. Do not shout for joy like the other nations, because you have been unfaithful to your God. You love the wages of a prostitute on every threshing floor.
But the threshing floors and winepresses will not feed the people, and the new wine will fail them.
They will not stay in the LORD's land. Ephraim will go back to Egypt, and they will eat unclean food in Assyria.

They will not pour out wine offerings to the LORD, and their sacrifices will not please him. Their sacrifices will be like the bread of mourners, and everyone who eats it will become unclean. Their food will only satisfy their hunger. It will not be brought into the house of the LORD.
What will you do on the day of your appointed festivals, on the feast days of the LORD?
Even if they escape from the destruction, Egypt will gather them up, and Memphis will bury them. Weeds will grow over their treasures of silver, and thorns will cover their tents.

The days of punishment are coming. The days of payback are here. Let Israel know this. Because your sins are so many and your hatred is so great, the prophet is treated as a fool, and the inspired man as a madman.
The prophet, along with my God, is the watchman over Ephraim. Yet traps wait for him on all his paths, and hatred fills the house of his God.
They have sunk deep into wickedness, as in the days of Gibeah. God will remember their wickedness and punish them for their sins.

"When I found Israel, it was like finding grapes in the desert. When I saw your ancestors, it was like seeing the first ripe figs on the tree. But when they came to Baal Peor, they gave themselves to that shameful idol and became as disgusting as the thing they loved.
Ephraim's glory will fly away like a bird. There will be no births, no pregnancies, and no conceiving.
Even if they raise children, I will take every one of them away. How terrible it will be for them when I turn away from them!
I have seen Ephraim, like Tyre, planted in a pleasant place. But Ephraim will bring out his children to be killed."
Give them, LORD... what should you give them? Give them wombs that miscarry and breasts that are dry.
"All their wickedness began in Gilgal. There I began to hate them. Because of their wicked deeds, I will drive them out of my house. I will no longer love them. All their leaders are rebels.
Ephraim is struck down. Their root is dried up, and they will bear no fruit. Even if they have children, I will kill the children they love."
My God will reject them because they have not obeyed him. They will wander among the nations.
